regions: three equal horizontal intervals over min/max observed support of all valid frozen pairs; same intervals for every pair
evidence: union of actual foreground pixels of original evaluable C1 components; no PCA rasterization, GT, or extensions
containment: per-region inside-and-observed pixels / all evaluable pixels in region; empty denominators excluded and recorded; equal weight over nonempty regions
observed: within pair support and nearest paired_x distance <= frozen max_sample_gap
tie: if baseline R is among exact top-score ties retain R, otherwise original quality/spacing ordering restricted to tied pairs
fallback: no valid pair keeps original failure; no evaluable evidence or all scores zero retains R, explicitly flagged
measurement: frozen Round30/Round29 B geometry, UW and 25/50/25; no candidate filtering or geometry changes
raw_deficit: both raw 10px reference recalls >=0.8 is a local-support diagnostic, not proof of correct complete tracks
